title: Pit Board settings
question: Type bar, with the Text color picker open. It colors the letters, not a slot background. Lock it, or pick another.

options.label: Live sample
options.thesis: The selected slot’s text is drawn large, at the size and color you are setting, beside the plate.
options.viewport: Plate on the left with P2 selected. Beside it, a large P2 in the current ink, a Size slider reading 14, and a Color row. Slot menus sit underneath.
options.risk: The sample can crowd the plate if both try to be the hero.

options.label: Type bar
options.thesis: One bar sets the slot, the size, and the text color. The picker colors the letters on the plate.
options.viewport: Bar: Slot 2, Size 14, and a Text swatch. The picker is open: saturation square and hue bar. P2 on the white plate is orange. No fill behind the letters.
options.risk: An open picker covers part of the plate until you dismiss it.

options.label: Ink well
options.thesis: Color is a field of swatches. Size is a big number with plus and minus. Both sit next to the plate.
options.viewport: Plate on the left, P2 selected. On the right, Color as large swatches with black selected, and Size as 14 with minus and plus. Slot menus along the bottom.
options.risk: A big swatch field can look like a theme picker instead of one slot’s ink.
